sqlGroup.select: select a.id as id, a.remark as remark, date_format( a.created_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s' ) as createdTime, cs.`name` AS createdStaffName from jml_device_repair_history a left join jml_staff cs ON a.created_staff_id = cs.id where a.device_repair_id = #{deviceRepairId} order by a.created_time desc
